create_terminal_logger: create a TerminalLogger instance with a custom label and print function for logging to terminal
write_log_values: write a dictionary of key value pairs to the terminal using the TerminalLogger write method
serialize_logging_data: serialize a dictionary of logging data into a pretty printed pipe separated string
create_throttled_logger: create a TerminalLogger with a time delta to throttle how often values are written
format_key_value: format a snake case key into a title case string with spaces using the internal format function
